gloss: double line; strikethrough with two lines

definitions.gloss: double line, two parallel lines drawn through text
definitions.explanation: Two parallel lines drawn through text on a document to indicate a correction or deletion. The standard method for crossing out errors on official Japanese documents.

examples.japanese: ⟦{間違|まちが}い→間違い：03733_machigai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{二重線|にじゅうせん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{消|け}す→消す：00528_kesu⟧。
examples.english: Cross out the mistake with a double line.

examples.japanese: {修正液|しゅうせいえき}⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧{二重線|にじゅうせん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{訂正|ていせい}して→訂正する：10443_teiseisuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please correct it with a double line, not correction fluid.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公的|こうてき}→公的：06349_kouteki⟧な⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{二重線|にじゅうせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}いて→引く：01978_hiku⟧⟦{訂正印|ていせいいん}→訂正印：10287_teiseiin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{正|ただ}しい→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧⟦やり{方|かた}→やり方：10532_yarikata⟧です。
examples.english: On official documents, the correct method is to draw a double line and stamp a correction seal.

notes:
COMPONENTS: ⟦{二重|にじゅう}→二重：16893_nijuu⟧ (double) + ⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧ (line).

On official documents in Japan, correction fluid ({修正液|しゅうせいえき}) or erasers are not accepted for corrections. Instead, the proper method is to draw {二重線|にじゅうせん} through the error and stamp a ⟦{訂正印|ていせいいん}→訂正印：10287_teiseiin⟧ (correction seal).

The {二重線|にじゅうせん} is drawn with a ruler for neatness. The original text should remain legible beneath the lines — the point is to show what was corrected, not to hide it.
